title: Reduce Completed selected row export
summary: Removed the transitional Completed selected-row flat export while preserving the namespace helper on mediaPipelineCompletedView. Cross-page Sample Validation consumers and the Completed/Pending browser smoke now call mediaPipelineCompletedView.getSelectedCompletedRow(), and the WebView export inventory plus generated public contract baseline are refreshed to 505 flat exports.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup within the touched Completed/Sample Validation domain while preserving intentional browser test hooks and backend-owned mutation boundaries.
behavior_before: completedView.js exposed getSelectedCompletedRow both through mediaPipelineCompletedView and as a transitional window.getSelectedCompletedRow flat export. Cross-page Sample Validation helpers and the Completed/Pending browser smoke could still read the flat alias.
behavior_after: getSelectedCompletedRow remains available through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView only. The touched consumers use the namespace helper, the served Completed browser smoke fails if the removed flat assignment returns, and the documented flat-export count is 505 across 49 files.
tests_added: Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to require mediaPipelineCompletedView.getSelectedCompletedRow() and reject a served window.getSelectedCompletedRow flat assignment.
manual_validation: rg -n "window\\.getSelectedCompletedRow\\b" apps tests docs --glob '!docs/generated/summaries/**' (exit 1, no matches)
rollback_plan: Restore the window.getSelectedCompletedRow assignment in completedView.js, move the touched consumers back to the flat alias only if compatibility is intentionally required, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and rerun the same WebView/static validation ladder.
notes:
Source-media safety: this is a WebView compatibility-export cleanup only. It does not change backend routes, command confirmations, pending-publish manifests, filesystem mutation, media policy, FFmpeg arguments, repair/apply behavior, or source/scratch/output handling. No downloads or real-media validation are required for this low-risk frontend namespace cleanup.
